reports.title: Potent Categorical Representations

reports.arxiv_version_role: Versioned metadata inspected; the official SIAM HTML, not this preprint, was read as the complete main source.
reports.question: How can categorical representations retain the geometry of both monodromy and equivariant parameters, and can a torus 2-Fourier transform identify the Hecke monads for Langlands dual reductive groups?
reports.reading_scope: Read the complete official mathematical body, sections 1 through 4.4.3, acknowledgments, relevant bibliography and copyright/publication metadata. Supplementary sources were read only at the sections/statements recorded below. No forthcoming joint manuscript or full research proof is represented as read.

Verified in official HTML on 2026-10-18; pages 471-491 and publication date 2026-07-13 also verified. The license is not extended to supplemental papers.
reports.joint_work: The report explicitly attributes the new program to ongoing joint work with German Stefanich (Germán Stefanich in the original); reference [18] is an unpublished manuscript by Ben-Zvi, Nadler and Stefanich.
reports.coverage_status: 42 atomic knowledge pages plus a narrative outline. Extra foundations were split in response to atomicity review: derived tensor, derived affine, derived fiber product, derived stack, monad algebra and monadic adjunction. Main geometric/Hecke branches, physics motivation, trace/Hilbert/DAHA expectations, character TQFT, real and finite-group boundary examples are represented. This is not a reconstruction of all research proofs.

proof_scope.2S01: D-module definition and connection interpretation; generation of differential operators and stack descent are standard cited inputs, not proved here.
proof_scope.2S02: Derived-loop definition and homotopy-pushout explanation of diagonal self-intersection; mapping-stack foundations are external.
proof_scope.2S03: Explicit one-variable Koszul resolution and derived tensor calculation; B squared equals zero checked. General HKR compatibility with rotation is cited, not proved.
proof_scope.2S04: Torsor-automorphism argument for LBG=G/G and torus specialization; descent of the groupoid argument to stacks is used. The product is not asserted to have trivial rotation action.
proof_scope.2S05: Noetherian derived-scheme Ind completion definition and mapping formula; regular-scheme equivalence and extension to stacks/formal completions are cited.
proof_scope.2S06: Tate construction defined by homotopy invariants and inversion of the degree-two parameter; no localization theorem for arbitrary higher categories is proved.
proof_scope.2S07: Elementary localization criterion proved for modules and extended to complexes using flatness; higher categorical torsion is a separate source input.
proof_scope.2S08: Cited equivalence only for smooth separated finite-type characteristic-zero schemes in the main statement. Complex reductive BG is a separately sourced formal-loop example. BN Corollary 1.15 has a perfect-object scope; the report's IndCoh formulation also invokes Preygel. No claim of proving that extension or a theorem for arbitrary smooth stacks.
proof_scope.2S09: Definition 2.2 specialized explicitly to quotients of smooth separated finite-type schemes by smooth affine finite-type groups. Distinction between all loops and constant-loop completion explained, not a new equivalence theorem.
proof_scope.2S0A: Derived presentable stable module action explicitly defined. Existing 014P is only an ordinary abelian analogy, not the definition reused. Convolution and descent are standard inputs.
proof_scope.2S0B: Stefanich kernel formula cited in the precise subclass of smooth separated finite-type schemes with proper maps to a smooth base. Properness of the composition projection follows by base change. General higher sheaf construction and singular-support theory not proved.
proof_scope.2S0C: Report's proposed periodic base-change construction explained; nonconical cotangent graph is an elementary example. Full implementation in 3IndCoh belongs to joint work, not a universally established naive quotient formula.
proof_scope.2S0D: Expansion by additional test objects and announced Proposition 2.10; no proof of the higher equivalence. Elementary u-torsion calculation is only motivation.
proof_scope.2S0E: Report Definition 2.4 within its expanded higher sheaf framework; restriction to ordinary de Rham representations is not asserted to be an equivalence.
proof_scope.2S0F: Report Example 2.5 and its two evaluations cited as structural constructions. The ordinary geometric-point description is explained; it does not construct the higher linearization.
proof_scope.2S0G: Rank-one residue/gauge/monodromy calculation, using standard triviality of line bundles on the Laurent PID. General torus formula follows characterwise. Analytic monodromy does not identify the algebraic parameter stacks.
proof_scope.2S0H: Ordinary monad definition and adjunction motivation; higher coherent analogue described, not reduced to two equations in a homotopy category.
proof_scope.2S0I: Report Definition 2.11 and Borel loop-correspondence construction explained. The potent monad is not identified with an ordinary monoidal category.
proof_scope.2S0J: Theorem 2.12 announced in the report and attributed to joint work; monadicity is not independently proved.
proof_scope.2S0K: Theorem 2.9 announced, not reproved. The separate finite-dimensional symplectic coordinate identity is proved directly and does not prove the 2-categorical equivalence.
proof_scope.2S0L: Theorem 2.13 announced for the de Rham torus model only. Betti version remains the analytic-foundations expectation of Remark 2.14.
proof_scope.2S0M: Conjecture 2.17, including all monad coherence, remains conjectural. Resulting equivalence is conditional on the conjectural matching and announced monadicity.
proof_scope.2S0N: Ordinary-category proof transporting algebra actions through an equivalence compatible with monads. Higher categorical application requires the full coherent data; no nonabelian matching is proved.
proof_scope.2S0O: Closedness, nondegeneracy, invariance under dual lattice basis change, Lagrangian fibers and swap-inversion symplecticity checked directly. Betti/analytic picture distinguished from de Rham algebraic parameters.
proof_scope.2S0P: Ansatz 3.2 and physical motivation, not a proved symplectic-invariant RW construction. Stefanich Corollary 1.3 supplies a conical higher-sheaf field theory; periodic, expanded and general target comparisons remain separate.
proof_scope.2S0Q: Direct proof that the rank-one quantum-torus substitution preserves relations and has fourth power identity; not a proof that potent cyclic traces are DAHA modules.
proof_scope.2S0R: Higher trace definition by duality, elementary degree-zero Hochschild cocenter computation. The de Rham trace identification with D(G/G) is cited through the report, not proved.
proof_scope.2S0S: The GL_n Hilbert-scheme models are expectations, including unspecified forms of QCoh and algebraic/analytic qualifications. n=1 is only a consistency check using 2S14.
proof_scope.2S0T: The t=1 lattice quantum-torus crossed-product model locally decodes DAHA terminology. Potent cyclic characters are conjectural; the cited type-A quantum-D-module Springer-block input is not promoted to an equivalence of whole categories. Full (q,t) mixed theory is only hoped for.
proof_scope.2S0U: Potent 2-dualizability, 2-orientability and character TQFT are conjectural. Surface duality is conditional and is not ordinary Borel-Moore duality for arbitrary Langlands dual groups.
proof_scope.2S0V: Groupoid-level proof of twisted cocycles, gauge action, stabilizers and decomposition. Real/analytic geometric realization is separate from the groupoid computation.
proof_scope.2S0W: Conjecture 4.2. Quasisplit input specified as a real reductive group with an R-Borel and chosen complexification. Antiholomorphic real structure, complexified Cartan involution and source fixed-object notation are explicitly distinguished. Known fixed-parameter/quasisplit input does not prove potent uniform duality.
proof_scope.2S0X: Root-subsystem reflection closure and root/coroot exchange proved. Disconnected component groups and Frobenius rational structures are not determined by this calculation. Positive-characteristic potent categories and their trace equivalence remain proposed.
proof_scope.2S0Y: Definitions of the three source models with precise torus comparison; algebraic versus analytic distinctions retained, no unrestricted equivalence asserted.
proof_scope.2S10: Derived tensor through projective resolution and K-flat replacement recalled; independence/existence are standard homological-algebra inputs. Algebra multiplicative enhancement and sign convention explained.
proof_scope.2S11: Characteristic-zero connective commutative DG affine model, Koszul sign and odd-square-zero consequence. Homotopical localization is a foundational input.
proof_scope.2S12: Derived fiber product defined by homotopy pullback and affine derived tensor; Tor and flat specialization explained using existing definitions.
proof_scope.2S13: Extended TQFT and [0,2] layer conventions explained; cobordism hypothesis and dualizability criteria are external inputs, not proved.
proof_scope.2S14: Hilbert functor definition; representability cited. Length-two ideal examples and Hilb_1(S)=S proved by rank-one finite-flat algebra and graph argument.
proof_scope.2S15: Monad-algebra objects and morphisms defined independently; A tensor V example unpacked.
proof_scope.2S16: Monadic adjunction defined independently through the comparison functor; monadicity is not inferred merely from existence of an adjunction.
proof_scope.2S17: Derived stacks defined independently as space-valued etale descent data, with explicit derived etale criterion. Not every derived stack is asserted to be algebraic.

remaining_branches: SIAM §4.4.1 relative Langlands Conjecture 4.1 was read but its hyperspherical-variety definition and specific dual-pair examples are not developed into knowledge pages. A genuine atomic treatment needs the exact relative-Langlands sources, rather than an undefined label.
Full construction/proofs of periodic and expanded higher IndCoh, additive/multiplicative 2-Fourier and Hecke monadicity are external joint-work inputs. The report alone does not supply these proofs.

The main nonabelian Hecke-monad matching, algebraic versus analytic Betti foundations, symplectic invariance of general RW targets, and nonexact multiplicative RW models remain conjectural or incomplete in the source.
Hilbert trace models, potent character TQFT, precise K-theoretic description of potent surface homology, and full mixed (q,t) DAHA theory remain expectations, not established equivalents.

Real-group geometric enhancements and comparison with complexified Cartan models are not constructed here; only the groupoid cocycle calculation is proved. The dual involution is source data, not defined by notation.

Positive-characteristic potent categories, Frobenius trace construction, rational structures and disconnected centralizers require additional foundations; the local root-symmetry computation does not establish them.
The proofs of the ordinary character-sheaf trace theorem, quantum Springer-block/DAHA input, and Hilbert representability remain cited rather than independently reconstructed.

reports.speaker: Ben Davison
reports.title: BPS Cohomology in Geometry and Representation Theory
reports.outline_title: BPS 上同调：从表示叠的整性到 Hall 代数与几何表示论
reports.arxiv_version_role: Versioned preprint of the report. Official SIAM mathematical body is canonical; selected raw TeX was checked for shifts, signs and P=W status.
reports.copyright: Copyright 2026 International Mathematical Union; published by SIAM. Official article/abstract metadata explicitly confirms CC BY 4.0 and online publication on 2026-07-13. No license is inferred for supplements.
reports.question: How does finite-dimensional BPS cohomology reconstruct infinite representation-stack cohomology, explain integral and positive counting invariants, and generate Hall/Lie/Yangian structures and filtered nonabelian Hodge comparisons?
reports.reading_scope: Complete official SIAM mathematical body §§1-6, footnotes, relevant bibliography and publication/license metadata read. Supplements read only at listed definitions, theorem statements and selected proof/normalization passages. Raw mathematical TeX independently checked for BM duality, half-Tate shifts and super signs. No complete reading or reconstruction of supplemental research proofs is claimed.
reports.coverage_status: 40 atomic knowledge pages plus Chinese narrative outline; all main requested branches covered. P=W reuses canonical coprime theorem and retains stack conjecture status.

proof_scope.2T01: Defines quiver representations; proves equivalence with finite-dimensional left path-algebra modules by vertex idempotents.
proof_scope.2T02: Defines Euler, symmetric and antisymmetric forms; calculates stack dimension and the one-loop/A2 cases directly.
proof_scope.2T03: Constructs representation stack and invariant affine quotient; closed-orbit/semisimplification correspondence is a cited classical GIT input.
proof_scope.2T04: Defines Borel equivariant cohomology; explains BC* by CP-infinity; BGL Chern-class ring is a classical cited calculation, not re-proved.
proof_scope.2T05: Derives smooth quotient-stack dualizing shift from smooth-atlas exceptional pullback; duality formalism is an external foundation. Checks BC* and A2 times BC* explicitly.
proof_scope.2T06: Fixes shift, Tate and signed Poincare conventions. Existence of the monodromic half-Tate object is cited; does not assert an ordinary rational half-Tate Hodge structure.
proof_scope.2T07: Constructs super-symmetric algebra as tensor-algebra quotient and proves even/odd polynomial/exterior basis behavior.
proof_scope.2T08: Derives plethystic product and logarithm formulas from a homogeneous basis with explicit degreewise finiteness and completion hypotheses.
proof_scope.2T09: Proves formal uniqueness by dimension-degree recursion; derives the quadratic coefficient. Polynomial integrality is a separate theorem.
proof_scope.2T0A: Defines polynomial quiver potential and cyclic derivatives; proves Jacobi representation scheme equals trace-potential critical scheme using the nondegenerate trace pairing.
proof_scope.2T0B: Defines perverse-exact vanishing cycles and explains phi_0=id. Perverse exactness and Milnor-fiber comparison are cited sheaf-theoretic inputs.
proof_scope.2T0C: Computes reduced cohomology and monodromy of the m+1-point Milnor fiber. BPS identification and higher-dimensional vanishing use 2T0F.
proof_scope.2T0D: States precise hypotheses and shifts for three presentations; verifies relation-free BM normalization against ordinary cohomology using 2T05.
proof_scope.2T0E: Defines BPS sheaf and Lie-shifted cohomology via perverse truncation. Decomposition, positivity and first-layer embedding are DM integrality inputs.
proof_scope.2T0F: Cites symmetric-quiver BPS/IC theorem with zero-fiber restriction for potentials; derives simple-locus dimension and correct virtual IC exponent.
proof_scope.2T0G: Cites cohomological integrality and finite-dimensionality; proves Laurent integrality and integer Euler characteristic from those inputs.
proof_scope.2T0H: Proves q-binomial recurrence and product formula; BPS calculation uses the simple-representation theorem.
proof_scope.2T0I: Proves only one-dimensional simple Jordan representations exist; applies IC theorem and checks equivariant contraction and Hilbert product.
proof_scope.2T0J: Cites linear-potential dimensional reduction; independently derives its Tate exponent via compact-support reduction and Verdier duality.
proof_scope.2T0K: Defines doubled quiver and preprojective equations; computes Euler/relations normalization and one-loop example. Moment-map interpretation is standard.
proof_scope.2T0L: Computes all cyclic derivatives and proves Jac(tripled Q,W)=Pi_Q[omega] by mutually inverse presentations.
proof_scope.2T0M: Cites existence of Kac polynomial; proves the Jordan count q using 2T14, Frobenius invariance and a rational cyclic vector, without assuming the full PID module structure theorem.
proof_scope.2T0N: Cites preprojective purity and Kac/BPS comparison; derives nonnegative Kac coefficients and the Jordan Tate shifts.
proof_scope.2T0O: Derives commuting-stack partition product from 2T0N and integrality; independently checks rank-one stack duality and BPS-versus-Lie shift.
proof_scope.2T0P: Defines slope (semi)stability and slope-generic Euler condition; proves zero-parameter stability means simplicity.
proof_scope.2T0Q: Proves rank decomposition and complete stable/semistable classification in both A2 chambers.
proof_scope.2T0R: Cites cohomological wall crossing; derives ordered A2 pentagon from chamber classification and verifies its first mixed coefficient with the exact quantum sign.
proof_scope.2T0S: Defines extension correspondence and proves properness through relative Grassmannians. CoHA functorial construction, critical Gysin maps and associativity are cited, with their flag mechanism explained.
proof_scope.2T0T: Checks alternating bilinear tau, constructs psi and proves twisted associativity/sign cancellation. Associated-graded commutativity is DM Theorem C.
proof_scope.2T0U: Cites PBW/filtered multiplicativity; proves closure of P1 under supercommutators and explains super versus ordinary Lie distinction.
proof_scope.2T0V: Proves determinant Chern-class operator is an even derivation by determinant exact-sequence identity and projection formula; exhibits why its square need not be a derivation. Scalar stabilizer restriction c1(det V)=|d|u is included.
proof_scope.2T0W: Proves framed semistable=stable=cyclic and triviality of automorphisms fixing the frame.
proof_scope.2T0X: Defines framed moment quotient, explains smoothness/dimension via infinitesimal freeness and symplectic duality. CoHA module construction is cited, with all cohomological shifts retained.
proof_scope.2T0Y: Constructs complex Grassmann quotient charts locally, derives tangent/cotangent fibers, proves Nakajima variety=T*Gr and computes the f=2,d=1 cohomology.
proof_scope.2T0Z: Defines generalized Kac-Moody positive half by generators and Serre relations; records real/isotropic/negative diagonal assumptions. No full triangular-decomposition theorem is reconstructed.
proof_scope.2T10: Cites preprojective GKM theorem, specifies real and isotropic IC generators, sign twist and PBW. Small-diagonal Jordan example is explained; general 2CY research proof remains external.
proof_scope.2T11: Cites Botta-Davison comparison under an explicit admissible two-torus action; distinguishes full Lie comparison from Yangian positive-half algebra comparison. Stable envelopes are not reconstructed.
proof_scope.2T12: Computes differential-operator commutator and leading bracket; cites the C2 CoHA/enveloping comparison through the report. Explicit noncommutativity is proved.
proof_scope.2T13: Reuses established coprime P=W theorem; cites stack NAH vector-space/algebra comparison through report. Retains stack P=W as Conjecture 5.2, does not assert a naive formula for its technical stack filtration, and explains necessary filtered compatibility.
proof_scope.2T14: Proves primary decomposition using polynomial Bezout, nilpotent block splitting by an explicit commuting projection, and indecomposability of one block using polynomial division.

Full vanishing-cycle/MHM formalism, monodromic tensor structure and linear-potential dimensional-reduction proof are cited; local Milnor calculations and Tate exponent conversion are written.

General smooth-surface CoHA and pure-cohomology/trivial-canonical hypotheses, and the threefold point-sheaf conjecture (§4.3), are only summarized; only the C2 differential-operator model is developed.

Stack nonabelian Hodge and algebra comparison proofs are cited via §5.4. The technical stack perverse filtration and Conjecture 5.2 are not replaced by a naive coarse-moduli formula. Coprime P=W is reused from 0J0K.
General symmetric-stack central-rank/Levi integrality and three-manifold Langlands-dual BPS conjecture (§6) are narrative-only; the conjecture remains open as stated in the report.

reports.coverage_status: 40 atomic knowledge pages plus narrative outline. Explicit elementary proofs and calculations accompany the reduction route; deep type construction, parameter theory and localization theorems are cited inputs.

proof_scope.2U01: Definition of smoothness; open-stabilizer/continuous-orbit equivalence explained. Unused admissibility definition removed to preserve atomicity; global finite-dimensionality not required.
proof_scope.2U02: Compact induction for open subgroups over a commutative ring; finite support modulo the subgroup and smoothness proved by a finite intersection of stabilizers.
proof_scope.2U03: Full explicit Frobenius reciprocity proof, with representative independence, equivariance and mutually inverse maps; valid over commutative rings.
proof_scope.2U04: Pro-p definition and GL_n congruence-quotient computation; completeness yields the inverse limit. Closed-subgroup inheritance used as standard profinite structure.
proof_scope.2U05: General Moy-Prasad construction and reductive quotient structure cited. Standard GL_n vertex filtration written explicitly; point stabilizers distinguished from parahorics.
proof_scope.2U06: Depth definition with r+; attainment and depth-zero invariant-vector criterion cited from minimal K-type theory in nondefining characteristic.
proof_scope.2U07: Definition for general coefficient modules; irreducible criterion proved by conjugation invariance of the sum of invariant spaces.
proof_scope.2U08: SL_2 reduction and inflation example; surjectivity follows by lifting elementary matrices, and equality of invariant subspaces follows from surjectivity.
proof_scope.2U09: Smoothness and depth-zero generation explicitly proved. Irreducibility and supercuspidality of the SL_2 compact induction are cited, not inferred from one invariant vector.
proof_scope.2U0A: Normalized parabolic induction over C, positive modulus square root and GL_2 modulus formula. Compactness of the flag quotient is a standard structural input.
proof_scope.2U0B: Cuspidal/supercuspidal definitions in nondefining characteristic. Supercuspidal implies cuspidal directly; converse over C and possible modular failure cited.
proof_scope.2U0C: Definition using all compact subgroups; GL_1 parameter z and triviality on units proved by the valuation of a compact subgroup.
proof_scope.2U0D: Inertial equivalence definition and GL_1 example; existence and uniqueness of complex supercuspidal support cited.
proof_scope.2U0E: Bernstein product decomposition and indecomposability cited. Vanishing of morphisms and extensions between different factors derived formally in a product category.
proof_scope.2U0F: Type definition for a single complex block; Frobenius reciprocity reformulation. No general existence claimed here.
proof_scope.2U0G: Convolution with plus-rho covariance, finite support, representative independence, unit and finite-sum associativity explained.
proof_scope.2U0H: Full kernel/endomorphism identification with an explicit inverse, finite-dimensionality ensuring compact support. Algebra is End(P), not its opposite.
proof_scope.2U0I: Bushnell-Kutzko progenerator theorem cited. Right precomposition action and balanced-tensor inverse explained; ordinary unital right modules, consistent with 0193.
proof_scope.2U0J: Laurent convolution computation, inverse eigenvalue convention t=z^-1 and explicit nonsplit two-dimensional Jordan extension proved.
proof_scope.2U0K: Tree path counting proves T_s^2=(q-1)T_s+q; affine Bruhat decomposition and identification of the Iwahori algebra are external inputs. Conversion to 018Q normalization explicit.
proof_scope.2U0L: Tame splitting and Weyl-order hypotheses defined; GL_n, SL_2, Sp_4 and E_8 exclusions computed from Weyl group orders. Rootless characteristic-two case separated.
proof_scope.2U0M: Twisted Levi definition and unramified quadratic norm-one torus in SL_2. Anisotropy explains why it is not an F-parabolic Levi.
proof_scope.2U0N: Kim-Yu construction, Fintzen exhaustion and depth-zero input theorem cited. Data shape and output explained; full genericity and admissible-building conditions remain the cited D1-D5, not an independently reconstructed construction.
proof_scope.2U0O: Explicit finite Heisenberg representation; group law, representation law, coordinate projectors, irreducibility and scalar commutant proved. Central-subgroup commutant is the full matrix algebra.
proof_scope.2U0P: Quadratic correction and Sp_4 obstruction cited from AFMO II Appendix A.2. Only failure of a support-preserving isomorphism without the twist is asserted; no claim ruling out every abstract algebra isomorphism.
proof_scope.2U0Q: Twisted group algebra and crossed product defined; associativity follows directly from the normalized 2-cocycle equation and action law. Unequal Hecke parameters explicitly allowed.
proof_scope.2U0R: Support-preserving Hecke isomorphism and index-square-root formula cited, restricted to K_M0=M0(F)_x0. This guarantees the extra normalizer hypothesis imposed at the opening of AFMO II section 4.3, beyond Definition 4.1.1. Defined first over C; broader nondefining algebraically closed coefficients are a separate scope statement, not a modular block equivalence.
proof_scope.2U0S: Formal derivation of complex block equivalence from exhaustion, type equivalences and Hecke isomorphism. Those three inputs remain cited research results; torus twisting handles the rootless p=2 case separately.
proof_scope.2U0T: Affine-Hecke/twisted-group algebra structure and positive rational parameters cited, with the same normalizer-compatible K_M0=M0(F)_x0 input as 2U0R. Double-coset scalar interpretation and low-rank checks explained.
proof_scope.2U0U: Exact coefficient rings and specified unital algebra maps defined. A0 for parameter subcategories is distinguished from A for Heisenberg-Weil equivalences; examples and characteristic-p exclusion explained.
proof_scope.2U0V: Complete finite-quotient proof of character averaging: independence of the chosen open normal subgroup, idempotency, image and exactness.
proof_scope.2U0W: Direct cyclic modular group algebra k[u]/u^ell calculation and nonsplit length-two extension. This is an obstruction to automatic semisimplicity, not a claimed counterexample to a specific p-adic support theorem.
proof_scope.2U0X: Local Weil/inertia groups and relevant wild-parameter indexing defined. General Langlands parameter theory and finiteness of the wild image are standard structural inputs, not proved.
proof_scope.2U0Y: Independence of the cocenter Weil action from the extension proved by inner automorphisms. Connected Levi centralizer, geometric embedding class and dual identification cited through the survey and preprint introduction; technical section 2 proofs not read in full.
proof_scope.2U0Z: Idempotent-generated subcategory defined. Orthogonality, local finiteness, compatibility and Serre closure are cited results; trivial wild parameter is directly identified with the depth-zero definition.
proof_scope.2U10: Equivariant coefficient systems, face orientation and Cartesian condition defined. Representation-to-system construction explained; general localization/recovery theorem not proved here.
proof_scope.2U11: H0 as the nonequivariant face-diagram colimit, with inherited group action. Full finite-support leaf-elimination proof for constant systems on a tree; not a proof for arbitrary nonconstant systems.
proof_scope.2U12: Dat-Fintzen v1 preprint theorem, restricted to odd p, tame splitting and p not dividing the absolute Weyl order. Product factors and equivalences cited. Indecomposability only asserted over Zbar[1/p], using Dat-Lanard.
proof_scope.2U13: Proof outline with explicit local tensor/Hom functors. Hom is over K-dagger, not the scalar subgroup K+; the progenerator claim is in the specified K+-character subcategory. Localization, compatible Heisenberg-Weil systems and whole-building extension are external research inputs; no full proof claimed.
proof_scope.2U14: Direct GL_1 filtration computation d=max(a-1,0), conductor cases and mutually inverse character-twist functors. No nonabelian generalization inferred.

remaining_branches: Full Bruhat-Tits group schemes, general Moy-Prasad filtrations and attainment of depth remain structural inputs; only standard GL_n and GL_1 filtrations are computed here.
Full Kim-Yu D1-D5 genericity, Howe factorization, all Heisenberg-Weil extensions and Fintzen exhaustion proofs are not reconstructed.
AFMO compatibility and support-preserving isomorphism proofs, affine parameter identification and the complete Sp_4 untwisted obstruction proof remain cited.

The complex theorems do not supply a general modular Bernstein/type equivalence. The elementary cyclic modular example illustrates nonsplit extensions, not the specific Dat/Dudas support counterexamples.

Dat-Fintzen is cited as the 2026-02-12 v1 preprint. Wild-parameter centralizer theory, local idempotent compatibility, Cartesian localization and extension across the whole building remain research inputs.

Broader per-parameter non-torsion-prime hypotheses from Dat-Fintzen v1 are recorded as source scope, not promoted to an all-representations theorem. The notes state the uniform odd-p, tame, p-not-dividing-Weyl-order subcase.

Residual characteristic two tori are treated by character twisting on the complex side, but are not included in 2U12's integral theorem. Wildly ramified groups and characteristic-p coefficients are outside the stated reduction.
No claim identifies a whole depth-zero representation category with the representations of one finite group. Finite reductive data still require Hecke parameters or building gluing.

Independent canonical pages for generic characters, Heisenberg-Weil extensions and nonsplit L-groups could be useful later; no shared foundation file was modified. No diagram was needed for the explicit tree-counting argument.

terminology.smooth: Each vector has open stabilizer; no differentiability or global finite-dimensionality requirement.
terminology.induction: Functions satisfy f(hg)=rho(h)f(g), with right translations pi(g)f(x)=f(xg). Open-subgroup compact induction has finite support on H\G, not necessarily compact support in G if H is not compact.
terminology.hecke: Plus-rho covariance Phi(k1 g k2)=rho(k1)Phi(g)rho(k2); convolution over right cosets G/K; H=End_G(c-ind rho), and Hom(P,V) is a right H-module. In GL_1, T_varpi acts on the character module by chi(varpi)^-1.
terminology.affine_parameter: Iwahori generators satisfy (T_s+1)(T_s-q)=0. To match 018Q use v=q^-1/2 and T_s=q^1/2 H_s.
terminology.parahoric: 旁紧 follows existing usage; expanded/reduced buildings and compact versus compact-mod-center stabilizers explicitly separated.
terminology.block: Complex Bernstein blocks are individually indecomposable. Dat-Fintzen general-R factors are not all called blocks; indecomposability is stated only for Zbar[1/p] with Dat-Lanard input.
terminology.proof_status: Elementary proofs, conditional formal deductions, cited structural theorems and preprint results are separated page by page.
